command: mkdir -p .agents/logs && if docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec node {harness-dir}/playwright-mcp-wrapper.js docker run --rm -i mcp/playwright 2>>.agents/logs/playwright-mcp.log; else PW_BIN=""; for c in "$(npm config get prefix 2>/dev/null)/bin/playwright-mcp" "$HOME/.npm-global/bin/playwright-mcp" /usr/local/bin/playwright-mcp; do if [ -x "$c" ]; then PW_BIN="$c"; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$PW_BIN" ]; then echo "FATAL: @playwright/mcp not installed — run 'devbot install' (module playwright)" >&2; exit 1; fi; exec node {harness-dir}/playwright-mcp-wrapper.js node "$PW_BIN" --browser chromium 2>>.agents/logs/playwright-mcp.log; fi
